passages.note: Bill overview lists Payne as a co-sponsor of the single-subject ESA expansion; his House term is in the same legislature as his current Senate seat.

passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: New ARS 15-2401.01 makes any resident student eligible to enroll in public school (preschool-disabilities, kindergarten, or grades 1-12) a qualified student, regardless of whether they otherwise qualify under 15-2401 -- universal eligibility per the annex test.
House Third Reading roll call on final passage of the single-subject ESA expansion; Payne voted Y.

rows.reasoning: Payne co-sponsored and voted Y on HB2853 (2022), a single-subject bill whose new section 15-2401.01 makes any resident student eligible to enroll in public school (preschool for children with disabilities, kindergarten, or grades one through twelve) a qualified student for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account, regardless of whether they otherwise qualify -- the clause-for-clause match to rung 5's 'funding follows the student to any school.' His 2017-2023 House service is in-term for his current Senate seat under the same-legislature rule, matching the annex's own Kavanagh/HB2853 example.
